1.reproduce_code:
---
title: "Test"
subtitle: "Test"
author: "Test"
institute: "Test"
date: today
format:
  revealjs:
    hash-type: number   # <-- this setting causes the title slide misalignment
---

## Second Slide

Content on subsequent slides renders normally.
1.explanation:
1. Create a new Quarto document (e.g., broken-title.qmd) with the above YAML header.  
2. Ensure you have Quarto >= 1.2 (nightly build) installed.  
3. Render the document with `quarto render broken-title.qmd` or via `quarto preview`.  
4. Observe the first slide: the title remains centered, but the subtitle, author/institute, and date block shift to the left.  
5. To see correct behavior, change `hash-type: number` to `hash-type: title` (or remove it) and re-render – all elements will be centered on the title slide.
1.bug_scenario: When you specify format: revealjs with the option hash-type: number, the title slide content is no longer centered. The title may remain centered, but the subtitle, author block, and date shift to the left, producing a disjointed layout. In contrast, using hash-type: title maintains correct centering of all title‐slide elements.
